analysis: Adaptive agroclimatic variable-subset and K-means selection
feature_unit: location by selected variable-month climatological mean

search.strategy: greedy forward selection followed by backward removal
search.stability_metric: pairwise adjusted Rand index among resampled predictions

penalties.tiny_cluster_definition: fewer than max(3, ceil(2% of locations))

final_model.fit_scope: all retained locations after selection and audit

pca.selection: smallest component count reaching selected cumulative variance

scientific_boundary: Exploratory empirical partition; not causal variable discovery, an official agroecological classification, or external validation.
